reason: I would like help turning my projects into a clear resume, but setting up hosting and AI credentials feels like too much work while I am preparing for placements. I would keep using tools I can open directly on my phone or laptop.

would_change_my_mind: A simple hosted version with a free student tier and clear controls over what the AI writes.
